name: SK Hynix
day_summary: KOSPI BLACK TUESDAY REVERSAL. SK Hynix staged a sharp recovery on June 24 KST, tracking the broader KOSPI +3.26% (8,471.02) rebound from Monday's 'Black Tuesday' double-circuit-breaker session (-9.99%). SK Hynix estimated close ₩2,638,000 (+3.25%, +₩83,000 from ₩2,555,000 June 23 close) — medium confidence. The framework stop at ₩2,540,000 was NOT triggered on June 23's daily close (₩2,555,000) and remains intact today with ₩98,000 buffer. The KOSPI AI semiconductor sector led the recovery: NVDA premarket +1.6%, NVIDIA Annual Meeting at 9 AM PT confirming AI demand, and the Korea-wide forced-liquidation overhang from Monday's leveraged position unwind visibly clearing on lower volume. The session's most critical forward event is Micron Q3 FY2026 after the US close tonight (~20:30 UTC) — the direct HBM demand read-through for SK Hynix. A MU beat-and-raise (revenue above $34.66B, Q4 guidance above $36B, HBM sold-out status confirmed) drives a June 25 KST gap-up toward ₩2,700,000–₩2,800,000; a MU miss compounds the bear narrative and tests ₩2,540,000 on June 25 KST. ADR SEC clearance remains imminent (expected late June). The June 23 Korean media HBM4 capacity slowdown and Cheongju plant accident reports remain formally unaddressed by SK Hynix management.

analysis:
## Technical analysis

**Trend:** SK Hynix staged a recovery session on June 24 KST, estimated +3.25% close at ₩2,638,000, tracking the KOSPI +3.26% reversal from Monday's 'Black Tuesday.' The YTD trend remains massively bullish (+285%+ from January 2026 est.) despite the June 23 -12.47% single-session crash from the ATH.

**Pattern:** The June 23 blow-off-top reversal + June 24 recovery is forming a potential two-session hammer-and-recovery pattern at the ₩2,536,000 intraday low support. If the June 25 KST session (post-Micron Q3) extends the recovery above ₩2,700,000, the pattern becomes a classic V-bottom reversal from the ATH exhaustion. If Micron Q3 disappoints tonight, the June 24 recovery becomes a technical dead-cat bounce and the ₩2,540,000 stop becomes the live execution level.

**Volume:** June 24 estimated 4–6M shares vs June 23's 8.05M — lower volume on the recovery day is constructive. The selling was concentrated in a single elevated-volume session (June 23), and the reduced volume on the recovery day suggests institutional distribution is not ongoing. A June 25 KST recovery on normalized volume (2–4M) post-Micron beat would confirm the institutional exhaustion thesis.

**Strongest support — ₩2,540,000 (★):** The framework stop that survived both the June 23 intraday breach (low ₩2,536,000) and the June 23 daily close (₩2,555,000). The two-consecutive-close rule requires two KOSPI daily closes below ₩2,540,000 for full exit execution. June 24 estimated close ₩2,638,000 provides ₩98,000 buffer. Tonight's Micron Q3 is the binary — a miss could drive a June 25 KST close below this level.

**Strongest resistance — ₩2,919,000 (★):** The June 22 ATH close. To resume the bull trend on a closed basis requires reclaiming this level. Near-term, the ₩2,700,000–₩2,800,000 zone is the first resistance from the recovery pattern. A Micron Q3 beat-and-raise drives the first test of this range on June 25 KST.

**Decision points:** ₩2,540,000 (framework stop; two daily closes below = full exit) and ₩2,700,000–₩2,800,000 (Micron Q3 beat target for June 25 KST; add on break above this zone with confirmation).

**Invalidation:** A daily KOSPI close below ₩2,536,000 (June 23 intraday low) or a Micron Q3 HBM revenue miss and Q4 guidance below $33B would invalidate the short-term hold read and require full exit execution.
